# 11 — Optimize Gameplay Performance During Heavy Action

You are working on the NovaBurst React Native mobile game.

Goal:
Improve gameplay smoothness and responsiveness under load.

Tasks:
- identify unnecessary re-renders
- optimize animation updates
- optimize particle rendering
- reduce expensive state updates
- improve touch responsiveness during intense gameplay

Requirements:
- stable FPS on Android
- smooth gameplay during late-game action
- responsive controls at all times
- lightweight update loops

Acceptance criteria:
- gameplay remains smooth during heavy spawning
- controls stay responsive
- reduced frame drops and stutters
